statement.text:
Based on the development of E. S. Golod’s construction (see, for example,
Discrete Math. Appl., 23, no. 5–6 (2013), 491–501), for each prime number p, con-
struct a finitely generated residually finite p-group with a non-trivial finite centre.
Such groups with infinite and trivial centres are known (see 9.76 and Archive 11.101).
                                                                           A. V. Timofeenko
